conventions.errors: Branch on slug or code. Every error has message, hint and documentation_url.
conventions.lesson_identity: Use lesson:<level>:<slug>, or supply explicit level. Ambiguous slugs are rejected.
conventions.idempotency: POST /v1/me/spend-quotes (academy_prepare_spend) requires learn:write, credits:spend and Idempotency-Key despite creditEffect: none. GET premium preview returns quote: null. Approve the pending quote separately at /dashboard/agent before spending with consent: { userConfirmed: true, quoteId, maximumCredits } and its own Idempotency-Key. Only explicit OAuth grants can spend; personal keys and sessions cannot.
conventions.anonymous_bucket: Anonymous callers share a conservative bucket unless ACADEMY_TRUSTED_PROXY_IP_HEADER explicitly names a trusted, replaced ingress header.
conventions.private_cache: Private and credentialed responses use private, no-store and Vary: Authorization. Cookies never authenticate REST.
